description_en: Switches or rolls back a migration task for a one-click upgrade from RDS to PolarDB
description_zh: 切换或回滚RDS一键升级到PolarDB的迁移任务
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-migration --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --source-rds-db-instance-id rm-000000000000 --new-master-instance-id pc-00000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterMigration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source RDS instance
parameters.name: source_rds_db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the new instance or cluster. Valid values:

Before the switch, enter the PolarDB cluster ID to perform a switch.

After the switch, enter the RDS instance ID to perform a rollback
parameters.help_zh:
新的实例ID或集群ID，取值范围如下：
切换前，填写PolarDB集群ID进行切换。
切换后，填写RDS实例ID进行回滚
parameters.name: new_master_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to switch the endpoint. Valid values:

true: Switches the endpoint. The application can connect to the database without changing its connection configuration.

false: Does not switch the endpoint. The application must be changed to use the new PolarDB endpoint.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要切换连接地址，取值：

true：带地址切换（应用程序不用改连接配置）。
false：不带地址切换（应用程序需要改为新的PolarDB连接配置）。

默认为false
parameters.name: swap_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The specific endpoints to be switched. The value is a JSON string that specifies the endpoints to be swapped.

This parameter is valid only when SwapConnectionString is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
需要切换的具体连接地址。取值为需要两两交换的地址对应的JSON串。
当SwapConnectionString取值为true时生效
parameters.name: connection_strings
